manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the black and white plastic microphone from the table and pass it over.

Task description: This round’s object is the plastic microphone on the right side of the table, with a black handle and light-colored mesh head. Transfer it from the right gripper to the left gripper.

Success criteria: The microphone is left of the robot centerline and raised in the air to approximately the initial gripper height of both arms or higher. The left gripper is closed and physically holds the microphone, while the right gripper is open to complete the handover. Merely lifting it from the table while the right gripper still holds it is insufficient.

## Execution tips

- With the right gripper, choose a section near the tail of the black handle that still fits the full pad, avoiding the very end. Leave the section near the light-colored mesh head for the left gripper to reduce interference during handover.
- Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the selected handle diameter, with both fingers surrounding opposite sides. Before closing, confirm that the pads are actually on both sides rather than merely overlapping in the image without gripping.
- Reorient or move the microphone in an open space above the bowl rims, leaving room for both the mesh head and handle tail to swing. This reduces brushing the small bowl to the microphone's left.
- During the handoff, have the left gripper grasp the reserved section of the handle. Release the right gripper only after confirming the left has a secure hold, avoiding loss of microphone support and slipping.
